text: これで　こんどこそ　ほんとうに　ほんとうに　ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！

structure.jp: ほんとうに　ほんとうに
ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな　ポケモンずかんを
structure.en: a tremendous, wonderful and perfect Pokédex

structure.jp: かんせい　させるのじゃーッ！
structure.en: I will bring it to completion!

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな
patterns.explanation: To string several describing words together, each one except the last is put in its て or で shape, which works like 'and'. ものすごくて　すてきで　かんぺきな = 'tremendous, wonderful and perfect'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる is the 'make it do' shape of する, so with かんせい (completion) it means bringing something to completion yourself. かんせい　させる = 'to complete (it)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end adds strong feeling, here a firm declaration of what he is going to do. のじゃ is the old-man way of saying のだ, and the stretched ーッ is a shout. かんせい　させるのじゃーッ = 'I am going to complete it!'
